description:
Use code DANINBLUE at the link below to get an exclusive 60% off an annual Incogni plan: https://incogni.com/daninblue 

🔪 If you want to survive out here in nature, you’ll need to be well equipped—Good thing evolution has got you covered. Animals have evolved various kinds of weapons to defend themselves and kill. Here, I cover every type of weapon found in the animal kingdom.

Second Channel: www.youtube.com/@daninbluer

[CLOSED CAPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE ON THIS VIDEO]

FURTHER READING:
https://umimpact.umt.edu/en/publications/the-evolution-of-animal-weapons
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35790073/
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7893261/

WHO AM I?
Hey, I’m Dan. I double majored in biology and psychology and am now pursuing a PhD in evolutionary biology. I make deep-dive videos about broad topics in evolution, ecology, and psychology and try to give as well-educated and integrative explanations as I can. I plan to stick around on YouTube for a while, so I hope to see you around for years to come! Cheers.
